New_variable_name Proposed_value
exp_class temperature precipitation flood drought river height is removed from our analysis
exp_temp_scale 0: 0 day 1: 1-14 days; 2: 15-30 days; 3: 31-365 days; 4: >365 days; 99: missing
exp_spatial_scale multi-country; adm0; adm1; adm2; adm3; …; non-adm geography(points, groups of admin units that can’t be described as a single unit, degrees, etc.) If the administrative unit level is not clear in the paper, do a google search and add the website evidence to the comment. If the data is reported by a station or one location point without any smoothing or aggregation process, the spatial scale should be non-adm geography.
exp_source website link, database name, etc
out_class_metric incidence (magnitude: cases, incidence rate; reproductive number); occurrence (binary); other; not stated
out_class_case_presentation sero-incidence infections; suspected cases only; suspected and bacteriologically confirmed cases only; bacteriologically confirmed cases only; sero-incidence infections and bacteriologically confirmed cases hospitalization; deaths; other; not stated; If there are more than 1 methods, combine them together.If suspected cases were reported while the confirmed cases (the outcome) were estimated based on positive rates, then the outcome include both suspteced and confirmed cholera cases. If the paper says “confirmed cases”, this means that they are bacteriologically confirmed.
